ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black pixels localized centrally and along the trailing edges; high-intensity white contiguous zones localized at the distal tips of both left and right lobes with high-frequency mottled transitions at the boundaries.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 2-10 pixels; notable large jagged protrusion on the right distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges follow a strong convex curve toward the distal tips, transitioning to a jagged, multi-linear trailing edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple low-intensity circular clusters (mottling) embedded within the high-intensity white distal zones; potential barnacle attachment points visible as irregular white clusters along the jagged trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular serration and potential minor tissue loss on the far-right lobe tip, indicating historical environmental interaction or trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'peppered' pigmentation pattern where black pixels transition into the white distal fields in non-uniform clusters.
